BILL NUMBER:  S4092

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act in relation to allowing town justice James Dwyer to temporarily
reside outside of the town of Marcellus


 PURPOSE :
Allows Town Justice James Dwyer to temporarily reside outside the town
of Marcellus.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :
Amends Section 3 of the public officers law, to allow Town Justice
James Dwyer to temporarily reside outside the town of Marcellus until
such time that his term expires on December 31, 2011.

 JUSTIFICATION :
The Town of Marcellus has requested that the New York State
Legislature introduce and pass legislation that would allow Town
Justice James Dwyer to temporarily live outside the Town of Marcellus
until his term expires on December 31, 2011. Justice Dwyer has served
the Marcellus community for 26 years. However, due to a family medical
issue, Justice Dwyer recently sold his home and will temporarily be
residing with his wife in an assisted living facility in the Town of
Skaneateles. No such facility exists in the Town of Marcellus. Public
Officers Law requires that any individual serving in a town office
must be an elector of the town.  It is requested by the Town of
Marcellus that Justice Dwyer be allowed to complete his term as town
justice.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
New bill.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediately.
